About the Project

UBEL's ESRC main competition supports doctoral research across the UCL, Bloomsbury and East London partnership. Applicants move through pre-registration, preliminary selection and a full application stage; submitting only the final application is not sufficient to follow the advertised process.

Research Areas

  • Social sciences
  • Research methods
  • Doctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryTuition and living stipend; published 2026/27 minimum stipend GBP 23,805/year. Confirm the rate for the 2027 cohort.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsMulti-stage competition; fee support and eligibility depend on route.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round30 October 2026 pre-registration; 9 November preliminary; 1 February 2027 full application
LocationUnited Kingdom

How to Apply

  1. Complete pre-registration by 30 October 2026.
  2. Submit the preliminary application by 9 November 2026, following the selected pathway’s guidance.
  3. If invited, complete the full application by 1 February 2027.

About University College London

UCL is a partner in the UCL, Bloomsbury and East London Doctoral Training Partnership. The partnership supports social science doctoral research through a multi-stage ESRC funding competition across participating institutions.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
